items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: Well, I played a couple of times with Jo Jones and another one.

ctx.x: How did you -- did you -- who were some of the drummers that you liked to play with during those years?
Well, I played a couple of times with Jo Jones and another one. I forget his name offhand.

items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: we did that with Slam Stewart

ctx.x: Just hold it for a second while I change tape because we got a couple drummers I think we're going to talk about. So you were talking about J. C. Heard and when he joined Cab's band when Cozy had left to go to CBS. John Hammond finally got some things going where they would use some black people -

Dave Dexter, John Hammond, Raymond Scott - we were at Rockefeller Center. You was playing the Strand Theatre. I came to the Strand Theatre; I said, "Cozy, you are going to play with Raymond Scott at CBS." He said, "I'm with Fess." I said, "You're going to have to leave." Shortly after that - you know sometimes when we get into California there'd be 3 or 4 bands and you look up and you've got Cab, Duke, and Basie, and all of us will be there together. When we get there you know good and well that Cozy and I were…
